metadata.title: Sunday, May 22, 2005 - "Alien Abductions"
metadata.author: Robert H. Wolfe / Rich Norris & Joyce Nichols Lewis

entries.clue: Choose to whom to sell ill-gotten gains?
Like a coach after a tough game, probably
Tried to avoid, in a way
They're no good when they run
Things on which to hang things
